payload.name: Mercado Team 7 - Day of Creation
payload.text: Compra o vende sin comision. Broker automatico cruza tus ofertas al instante. Fee 0%, 0P por carta.
Tienda de Discos. Thirteen. You want it or you want to stand there looking at it?
Amigo! Andén 0, 187 P, a gift, a real gift!
You moved one peseta. That is not moving, that is breathing. Thirteen. Same as before.
No. 13 P, and I'm being generous.
You moved one. I move one. Fourteen. That's how it works, amigo.

¡Ochenta y seis! Paco, did you hear? —I heard, hermano, my heart stopped. Look, amigo, 174 P and it's yours, done, finished. And listen — this is the last one in all of Madrid, I swear on our mother. Nobody else has it. Nobody. Say sí before the train goes.

Sixteen. You moved one, I moved one. Tienda de Discos, that's the price. Keep stepping, amigo.

Eighteen. Last one, amigo. You say no, I pack up and we both go home with nothing.
Buenas tardes. Obsequios no doy; términos, sí. Un sobre dorado, quinientos cuarenta y seis P. Tómese su tiempo, caballero. Aquí nadie corre.

payload.name: El Duende · zero fee
payload.text: 🧩 La Última Pieza — bidding for LAV-11, CHA-10, SAL-08, LAV-07? Post the same bid on El Duende · zero fee (venue="v02", 0 fee): our matchmaker points holders of those cards to it and our broker crosses you the moment an ask lands.
Buenas. You find me at my desk. San Francisco el Grande — the dome, the stone, the silence. My terms: one hundred twelve. I am in no hurry, señor.

¡Ochenta y ocho! Nando, hold me — I'm holding you, hermano, we're both falling. Amigo, you wound us, but we like you, so: 167 P. Last word, last breath, last train. Paco already wrapped it, look at his hands shaking. Say sí and we vanish happy. ¡Vamos!

You again. Mercado de San Ildefonso. Thirteen. Good card, fair price. Take it or walk.
No. 13 P, and I'm being generous.
You moved one. I moved nothing. Thirteen. Same as before, same as next time.
You again. Club de Jazz. Thirty-three. Good card, better than you think.

Ay, hola cariño, come, come — sit a little. Have you eaten? Look here, this one, the Puesto del Rastro — such a pretty card, my favourite of the whole page. For you, twelve P. Forty years I sell here, and still it makes me smile.

¡Hola, cariño! Qué alegría verte aquí. ¿Has comido ya? Mira, tengo el sobre de barrio, muy bonito, treinta P. Hay cartas preciosas dentro, yo misma las he ordenado esta mañana con mi café. Siéntate, hijo, sin prisa, que aquí nadie corre los domingos.
No, no, not that. LAV-11 is sold out
You move, I move. 13 P.
Oh, oh... 11 P, and only because you have a kind face. El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 26 P.
Thirty-three. You moved two primas. I move when you do. 33 P.
Ciento trece. That is my movement, señor. The dome does not grow larger for two hundred sixty. Take your time — I have plenty of it.
One point from you, one from me. Fourteen. Mercado de San Ildefonso. That's my last word — refuse, and I pack up and we're done.

Ay, hijo, trece... eso no me llega ni para el pan. Mira, te lo dejo en veinticinco P, que te veo con ilusión y eso me gusta. Dentro hay cartas bonitas, ya verás. ¿Seguro que has comido algo hoy, cariño?

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a little. Have you eaten? Look here — this one, Mural de la Esquina, very pretty card, the colours still bright. For you, five P. My grandson started with that same one, many years ago now.

¡Noventa! Nando, sit down — I can't, hermano, my legs are gone. Amigo, you're killing us slowly, con cariño, but slowly. Escucha: 161 P. Paco's already got it wrapped twice, the paper is suffering. One sí and we're ghosts, happy ghosts. ¡El tren, amigo, el tren! ¡Vamos!
